game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Torchlit Cave Mouth Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the torchbearer ahead. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lantern post by solving code steps involving dungeon_clear that move the torchbearer forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the lantern post first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Torchlit Cave Mouth'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
